_comment: #378/#722. When each provider's free window resets or ends, so a $0 run does not silently become a paid one. `derive` names a cadence core/reset_window already encodes (youtube = midnight Pacific, apify = APIFY_RESET_DAY) - prefer it, because a typed recurring date rots (the typed YouTube row read CLOSED the day after it was written). `resets` is a typed recurring boundary for providers nothing in the repo can read; `ends` is a one-off promo. Omit all three when the terms are genuinely open-ended - the calendar reports that as unknown rather than treating it as safe.

windows.note: $5 free actor credit; the two paid signals (tiktok_trends, youtube_competitors) draw on it
free tier has no published end date - verify before relying on it for a paid run
per-model :free slugs are retired without notice; a dead slug is recorded by the router breaker
character quota; typed because nothing reads the subscription reset - TTS is the dominant per-video cost
